description: Hand a crew the user took over back. First commit and push the branch, then pass the pushed commit as `headSha` (`git rev-parse HEAD`): a branch GitHub reports at another commit is refused with branch_not_pushed and the crew stays with the user; a crew whose runner has not stopped yet is refused with crew_still_stopping (wait, fetch again, retry). The crew resumes from the branch and its Engineer starts with `note`. With `release: true` the claim is released and the crew stays halted instead (no push needed). Only the person holding the crew may hand it back (crew_taken_over otherwise; anyone who may release it can use release: true). Refused with crew_not_taken_over when nobody holds it. Only call when the user asks to hand it back. Requires `approve` scope and a key that belongs to a person.

headSha.description: The full SHA of the pushed commit. Required unless release is true.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

note.description: What was done and what is left, for the Engineer (max 4000 characters).

ref.description: A work item id, crew id, pull request URL or branch name.

repo.description: The repository (owner/name) a branch name is looked up in. Pass it with a branch; a branch in several repositories is refused as ambiguous_ref without it.
